fields.Name: T336 - Editor Save and Preview Validation Gating
fields.Description: Exercises the CanSave (Name + EntityID + RulesValid) and CanPreview (CanSave + rules>0) getters that disable the toolbar — a validation-gating behavior, not a generic required-field save block.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open 'Bulk Operations', click 'New operation' to open a blank editor. Before filling anything in, observe the toolbar: the 'Save' button should be DISABLED (a new operation needs at least a Name and an Entity), and 'Preview changes' should also be disabled (it additionally needs at least one rule). Now type a Name in Basics and choose an Entity in 'What it acts on'; verify 'Save' becomes ENABLED. 'Preview changes' should remain disabled until at least one field rule is added. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Seeing the buttons gate on required inputs (disabled → enabled) is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: On a blank new operation, 'Save' and 'Preview changes' are both disabled
After entering a Name and selecting an Entity, 'Save' becomes enabled while 'Preview changes' stays disabled until a rule exists
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
